process_area.title: Occupational Health Clinic & Medical Case Management

value_stream.name: Occupational Health, Safety Clinic & Employee Wellness

workflows.name: Company Clinic Operations & Occupational Health Nurse Coverage

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logs every case in occupational health record system" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews complex cases" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-478 (ensure controlled execution — Occupational Health Clinic & Medical Case Management (PA-83.1).)
- operational: ratio-based staffing plan and third-party coverage contracts
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: DOLE-mandated clinic coverage gaps; mitigated by ratio-based staffing plan and third-party coverage contracts
System Touchpoints: - Occupational health record system; clinic scheduling; medical supply inventory

steps.activity: OH Nurse Manager maintains nurse/doctor coverage plan: resident nurse at large DCs/HQ, rotating coverage at regional store clusters per DOLE Clinic Ratio (1 nurse per 200–300 employees)
OH Nurse operates clinic: walk-in consultations, vital signs, dispensing, emergency first aid, referral; logs every case in occupational health record system
Company Physician conducts scheduled consults and oversees clinical protocols; reviews complex cases; signs medical clearances

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, Store/DC Manager, Employee, HSE
fields.Trigger: Employee injury or illness at work

workflows.name: Workplace Injury / Illness First Aid & Medical Case Opening

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "OH Nurse opens medical case in record system" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "tracks recovery and case closure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: trained first-aiders at every location
Pain Points / Risks: - **Care risk**: Delayed first aid worsens outcome; mitigated by trained first-aiders at every location
System Touchpoints: - Occupational health record system; OHS incident linkage; HSE case workflow

steps.activity: OH Nurse/first-aider provides immediate first aid; stabilizes; transports to network hospital if needed; notifies manager and HSE
OH Nurse opens medical case in record system: incident description, body part, severity, witness, work-relatedness indicator
HSE links medical case to OHS incident (W140 linkage); coordinates investigation; tracks recovery and case closure

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, Company Physician, HMO, Employee
fields.Trigger: Case requires care beyond clinic capacity

workflows.name: Referral to Network Hospital, Specialist & Diagnostics Management

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinates appointment and pre-authorization with HMO" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Employee attends referral" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews specialist findings" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-478 (ensure controlled execution — Occupational Health Clinic & Medical Case Management (PA-83.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Continuity risk**: Lost referral records fragment care; mitigated by centralized case file
System Touchpoints: - HMO pre-authorization; network hospital directory; medical case file

steps.activity: OH Nurse/Physician refers to accredited network hospital/specialist; coordinates appointment and pre-authorization with HMO
Employee attends referral; OH Nurse tracks diagnostics, specialist report, and treatment plan in medical case file
Company Physician reviews specialist findings; adjusts work restrictions; coordinates treatment escalation if needed

fields.Participants: Benefits, OH Nurse, Employee, SSS, PhilHealth, HMO

workflows.name: SSS EC / Sickness Benefit & PhilHealth Claim Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, employer certification, attendance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Benefits files SSS EC/Sickness or PhilHealth claim" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconciles claim proceeds to employee salary continuation and HMO payments" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Benefit risk**: Missed filing forfeits employee benefit; mitigated by 10-day filing SLA and checklist
System Touchpoints: - SSS EC/Sickness filing portal; PhilHealth claims; benefits GL

steps.activity: Benefits/OH Nurse compiles SSS Employees' Compensation (EC) claim or Sickness Benefit documentation: medical records, employer certification, attendance
Benefits files SSS EC/Sickness or PhilHealth claim; tracks adjudication; remits necessary employer documents
Benefits reconciles claim proceeds to employee salary continuation and HMO payments; closes case with employee communication

fields.Frequency: Event-driven; ~60–120 cases/year (every EC claim requires a work-relatedness determination, per W2852/W779 canon)
fields.Participants: Company Physician, OH Nurse, HSE, Legal, DOLE

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents medical opinion with evidence" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "prepares DOLE incident report and EC supporting documents" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "tracks claim adjudication and any DOLE inspection" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: physician-led assessment and legal review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Incorrect work-relatedness determination; mitigated by physician-led assessment and legal review
System Touchpoints: - Medical case file; DOLE/SSS EC documentation; archive

steps.activity: Company Physician determines work-relatedness per DOLE criteria (cause, conditions, time); documents medical opinion with evidence
HSE/Legal prepares DOLE incident report and EC supporting documents; submits to SSS within prescribed period
OH Nurse tracks claim adjudication and any DOLE inspection; archives documentation per retention requirement

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, Company Physician, HR, Store/DC Manager

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documents in medical case" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-schedule of "HR/Store Manager accommodates restrictions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitors recovery progress" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-478 (ensure controlled execution — Occupational Health Clinic & Medical Case Management (PA-83.1).)
- operational: physician-led clearance and restricted-duty accommodation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Re-injury risk**: Premature full-duty return worsens injury; mitigated by physician-led clearance and restricted-duty accommodation
System Touchpoints: - RTW clearance workflow; accommodation tracker; medical case closure

steps.activity: OH Nurse/Physician issues return-to-work clearance with any restrictions (light duty, no lifting, limited hours); documents in medical case
HR/Store Manager accommodates restrictions (reassign tasks, adjust schedule); ensures workplace supports recovery
OH Nurse monitors recovery progress; lifts restrictions on physician clearance; closes medical case

fields.Participants: OH Nurse, HR, IT Security, NPC
fields.Trigger: Continuous; record access or retention event

workflows.name: Medical Record Confidentiality, Consent & DOH Recordkeeping

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records under strict confidentiality in secured occupational health record…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "logs all access" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "OH Nurse Manager retains records per DOH/DOLE requirement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy risk**: Unauthorized medical-record access violates DPA; mitigated by segregation and access logging
System Touchpoints: - Occupational health record system; access control/logging; consent management

steps.activity: OH Nurse maintains medical records under strict confidentiality in secured occupational health record system; separates from general HR file
IT Security enforces role-based access (only OH staff); logs all access; obtains employee consent for any data sharing (HMO, SSS) per Data Privacy Act
OH Nurse Manager retains records per DOH/DOLE requirement (varies); executes secure destruction post-retention; supports NPC data subject requests

workflows.name: Clinic Pharmacy, First-Aid Station & Medical Supply Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "OH Nurse maintains clinic pharmacy inventory and first-aid station" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates cold-chain for sensitive items" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports expired/used items" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: monthly checks and DOLE-compliant stocking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Care risk**: Expired/missing supplies impair emergency response; mitigated by monthly checks and DOLE-compliant stocking
System Touchpoints: - Medical supply inventory; first-aid station checklist; FDA supplier validation

steps.activity: OH Nurse maintains clinic pharmacy inventory and first-aid station stock per DOLE-prescribed list; tracks expiry
Procurement sources medical supplies from FDA-licensed dealers; validates cold-chain for sensitive items; manages AED maintenance
Store/DC Manager conducts monthly first-aid station check; replenishes from clinic; reports expired/used items
